name: Outschool
long_description:
Outschool is an innovative education platform that offers a variety of engaging, small-group classes online. Unlike traditional classes, Outschool classes give kids the unique opportunity to explore their interests in-depth via interactive, live video by experienced, independent educators.

When Outschool was founded in 2015, homeschoolers were the first to discover our classes, but it wasn’t long before kids in conventional schools began supplementing their education with fun and unique, interest-based classes. During the COVID-19 pandemic, Outschool became vital to families who wanted to keep kids learning, social, and pursuing their passions.
Today, Outschool offers more than 140,000 live online classes to more than 1,000,000 learners in 183 countries worldwide.
one_liner: A live online learning platform that empowers kids ages 3–18.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: Growing up my parents knew how much I loved coding and engineering. Despite not being very wealthy, they prioritized my education and love of learning and hired a tutor for me to learn all about coding. It was the reason I believe I have come so far in my education and career. I know that without that assistance things may have been different. The inspiration for Outschool is that children have varied interests or may need to learn in a different way. Learning can be fun so that was how we decided that online classes taught by real teachers and tutors would help children continue to pursue their interests or excel academically even if they need to be taught using something fun like math with Pokemon.

question_answers.question: What's the history of your company from getting started until the present day? What were the big inflection points?
question_answers.answer: Our company began as a start-up with a large homeschooling population. In 2020 during the Covid-19 Pandemic when all children became homeschoolers, we truly caught on within the wider population. We began to expand internationally by 2021, and we have continued to grow ever since. We still serve a large homeschooling population and offer extracurricular activities and more academic classes for those looking for a different experience outside of traditional brick & mortar classrooms. We are currently in the process of expanding our tutoring offerings to help combat the issue of learning loss during the Pandemic.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: Do you remember sitting in chemistry class having to memorize the periodic table? Or reading a book in English class you couldn’t relate to at all? Learning doesn’t have to be dull, confusing, and completely unrelatable. Learning can and should be fun. Outschool’s mission is to inspire kids to love learning by linking learning and a child’s interests once again, making learning fun and accessible. For families needing more than conventional education has to offer, Outschool is the online learning platform that offers the widest variety of topics to suit any interest. With Outschool, learners are free to pursue their interests, connect with others around shared passions, and build confidence through progress. Outschool scales up the human connection between teachers and learners because we know interaction and engagement are what’s important for kids. \* **Quality:** We’re the established international market leader providing live online classes that are taught by vetted, diverse, and expert teachers since 2015. \* **Variety:** We offer the largest variety of teachers, classes, and community resources to inspire learners and support their families. \* **Flexibility:** Our range of class options and topics are suited to your child’s unique needs and learning level. \* **Access:** We provide an accessible option relative to private tutors, private schools, and after-school clubs. What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?

Eduflow is used by startups, large companies (like [Google](https://www.eduflow.com/blog/how-google-sales-training-uses-eduflow-to-create-a-culture-of-feedback-for-new-employees)), agencies (like [Animalz](https://www.eduflow.com/blog/how-animalz-built-stronger-team-connections-during-onboarding-with-eduflow)) and universities (like [ETH Zürich](https://www.eduflow.com/blog/how-eth-zurich-uses-peer-review-to-nourish-critical-thinking-skills)).

### **✨ What can you use Eduflow for?**

Due to the modular design of Eduflow, you can use it for any kind of training/learning challenge you have. Some of the most popular use-cases we see today are:

* **Employee onboarding** - give your new hires a great start with all relevant information. Use our social features to let them interact with their new colleagues and get to know each other.
* **Sales training** - train pitching and writing skills with video submissions, peer reviews, manager reviews and other active learning elements.
* **Leadership training** - manager and leadership skills are not easy to gauge with a multiple choice quiz. Use some of our social and active features to get people writing, reflecting and interacting.
* **Online bootcamps** - you can run your online school or bootcamp on Eduflow teaching everything from coding to sales and marketing.

We also have a library of course templates [here](https://app.eduflow.com/templates) where you can get more inspiration to get started.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
AccioJob was founded in 2018 by Vishu Bansal, Harsh Sharma, Priyanshu Agarwal and Yashwardhan Burad, four IIT Delhi alumni.\
All the founders were batchmates and friends from college since 2013.\
We were passionate about solving for employability for Indian college graduates. Spent the first couple of years iterating in this space from selling software solutions to colleges to B2B training products to reaching product market fit with B2C online and offline upskilling programs.

Before starting up, founders were active in the higher education market, speaking at events, exhibitions, conferences and guiding students making critical career decisions. Felt strongly about the problem at hand and enjoyed the journey of creating something valuable for people.

question_answers.question: What's the history of your company from getting started until the present day? What were the big inflection points?
question_answers.answer:
AccioJob was founded in 2018 by four IIT Delhi alumni and joined Y Combinator in W19 batch.

**2024 - the offline decision.** We moved from online only courses to offline centres enabling in person interaction, distraction free learning. 

**March, 2024 - first skill centre, Noida.** Learnt running an offline business. Refined pedagogies, build BTL GTM funnels, strengthened employer partnerships, made the centre run profitably in the first 8 months.

**November, 2024 - October, 2025 expansion.** Skill centres in Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, each near a live tech hiring market rather than in a metro centre for its own sake.

**Today.** Three programmes — Data Analytics with Gen AI, AI Engineering with Full Stack, and Data Science and AI — with 2,000+ students placed across 500+ hiring partners.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
India graduates over a million engineers a year, and most of them never get a fair shot at a tech job. The gap is rarely ability - it's structured practice, real feedback, and access to companies that are actually hiring.

Online courses didn't close that gap. Completion rates for self-paced programmes sit in the single digits, because a 21-year-old sitting alone with video lectures has no accountability, no peers, and nobody to ask when they're stuck at 11pm on a bug. The students who most need the training are the ones least served by a format that assumes they'll self-motivate through eight months of it.

So we built the opposite. AccioJob runs in-person skill centres where students show up daily, learn alongside a cohort, and get corrected by mentors in the room, delivering 2x better learning and placement outcomes. We then run the hiring side ourselves: 50+ hiring drives a month across 500+ partner companies, so the training connects to an actual interview rather than a certificate.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
If we succeed, where you studied stops determining whether you get a shot at a tech career.\
\
We believe strongly about the idea that employability will shift towards skills over degrees, towards capability instead of credentials. AI adoption in every domain of work will need human talent to be upskilled and reskilled. That’s the opportunity we are building for.

Every learner would think of AccioJob Skill centres as trusted institutions in their city which could help them with career guidance, personalising their roadmap, industry relevant actionable mentorship, being part of a professional community, structured upskilling programs, employment opportunities.

Concretely, that means skill centres in every Indian city with a tech hiring market, not just the four we run today, and a placement record that companies trust enough to hire from without a separate screening round.

In India, more than 5 million students set their sights on top careers in Engineering, Medicine, and Civil Services each year. However, they face significant hurdles in finding great mentors and teachers. [SuperKalam](https://superkalam.com/), a revolutionary AI-backed education initiative, comes to the rescue, empowering students with access to personalized mentorship in a discipline-inculcating learning ecosystem.

> SuperKalam prepares study plans and sets daily targets based on a student's progress, keeping track of common mistakes, performance and time spent on specific concepts or subjects. This innovative approach is already working wonders, and the aim is to scale this to reach 5 million students in India, starting with the Indian Civil Services Examination (UPSC).

Read on to discover the magical superpowers of SuperKalam!

[Vimal](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vimalsinghrathore/), alongside [Aseem](https://www.linkedin.com/in/-aseemgupta/), is the driving force behind building superkalam.com

Vimal, one of India’s top educators for more than 7 years, has witnessed the rise of edtech from the unique perspective of both founder and teacher during his tenure at unacademy and subsequently while building out his first startup in education, [coursavy (acquired by unacademy)](https://inc42.com/buzz/edtech-unicorn-unacademy-acquires-upsc-test-prep-platform-coursavy/)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73599&key=user_uploads/990441/aa5fca7e-ed8d-4ee3-9485-5a3f8b486782)

Current Edtech solutions primarily involve one-way content delivery, where thousands of students merely consume the content without engaging in effective discussions with the teacher. This leads to a loss of curiosity and, eventually, to poor learning outcomes. Furthermore, an excess of content leads to a multitude of choices, often resulting in confusion and chaotic, unplanned preparation.

**SuperKalam steps in to solve these issues with simplicity and focus.** Vimal has championed this process through his education initiatives over the past decade. Now, leveraging the latest AI technology, SuperKalam is fully equipped to scale founder’s counter-intuitive insights and learnings to assist millions of students in India, starting with the UPSC exam.

### **Solution**

## **TL;DR: Language learning that’s as unique as you are.**

If you’ve ever learnt a language, you’ve probably spent hours memorizing vocabulary or doing infinite grammar exercises only to then realize you can’t really… speak the language.

The [Univerbal](https://univerbal.app/) app helps you get confident to speak by practicing with real-life, open conversations with an AI conversation partner that adapts to your answers and your level. Most importantly, never judges you!

Your personal AI Tutor creates a language study plan combining both the language skills you’d like to work towards, based on CEFR language education standards and the conversation topics you’re interested in. **_No two study plans are the same because no two language learning journeys are the same._**

### **Try it for free:**

🌐 [Web app](http://chat.univerbal.app/) | 🍎 [Get the iOS app](http://univerbal.app/) | 🤖 [Get the Android app](http://univerbal.app/)

Watch the demo [here](https://youtu.be/gZs_F9J76xg) and try the app for free.

### 

## **🤔 The problem**

People learn a language to be able to speak it, but they end up memorizing vocabulary and doing boring grammar exercises and in the process, forget or they get too shy to actually practice speaking

Practicing with native speakers can feel like a burden, language tutors can soon get expensive and using some language apps can only get you so far.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85531&key=user_uploads/566264/8a04773c-911c-4f8d-bbdd-392e51ee0f0b)

## **💡 The solution**

We’re based in Switzerland: the country with 4 official languages🇨🇭 so it was only natural to try to solve this problem by building an AI-powered language learning app to help everyone increase their confidence to speak a new language.

Univerbal was born out of our own frustration as language learners (initially Philipp’s as he was learning Greek to connect to his Cypriot family heritage). It was obvious that the only way to get better was to speak, but it became both difficult to find the time for tutor sessions and very expensive 💸

Univerbal gives everyone access to a conversation partner and language tutor that’s customized to their own needs.

## **👉 How does it work?**

With the Univerbal app, each user gets a personal AI Language Tutor that creates a study plan based on the language goals they wants to work towards **and** the topics they’re interested in talking about.

Developed in collaboration with the Language Department at the University of Zürich, this ensures that everyone gets the language training based on CEFR language education standards, that’s also personalized to their own needs, skills and interests!

No two study plans are the same.

Users can practice with real-life conversations like ordering coffee or going for a job interview, get help from their AI Language Tutor in their own language and practice with short vocabulary exercises.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85531&key=user_uploads/566264/3a215c8e-39e0-4e0d-85fa-13e7e11b1d9e)

Synaptiq uses AI and neuroscience-based algorithms to personalize the learning experience of every user. By predicting when each user will forget each topic, the material is always reinforced at the optimal time, enabling doctors to retain their knowledge indefinitely. [Studdy](https://studdy.ai/) is an AI tutor for students. Anytime you need help with schoolwork (or any material you’re reading), **just snap a picture to get instant help from Studdy Buddy**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73856&key=user_uploads/1332645/ee2a0350-1b1c-4d20-aa05-b79c3254dfb0)

### The problem

Students are not getting the help they need to succeed in school. Every year, [**65%+ of all U.S. eighth graders**](https://www.nytimes.com/2022/10/24/us/math-reading-scores-pandemic.html) score **“below proficient,” in reading comprehension and math.**

The problem is that **class sizes are too large** for teachers to provide enough 1:1 help to every kid. Districts can’t afford to hire more teachers, and parents are unable to help their kids at home because they don’t know the material either.

When a student falls behind for just a couple of weeks, it can lead to a spiral of underachievement that ultimately leads to many kids giving up. Studdy is here to stop the spiral.

### How Studdy Helps

When students need extra help understanding material from class, **Studdy is available 24/7 to answer any questions and patiently explain any concepts**. Studdy never gets angry, impatient, or tired - and it loves answering follow up questions.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73856&key=user_uploads/1332645/bcb4d350-5c3e-474d-8a0e-ef6cf0ab1489)

Things Studdy can do:

* **Break problems down** into simple steps
* Answer **unlimited follow up questions**
* **Summarize** pages for you
* **Test** your reading comprehension
* Quiz you to make sure you **understand the “why”** of what you’re doing and aren’t just regurgitating homework steps
* Frame problems and **draw relationships** for you
* Speak to you at your grade level, **in your own language**
* Plus more!

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73856&key=user_uploads/1332645/bbb5e47e-6f23-4512-8723-d0fedc547559)

### Our Story

Alex and I built Studdy for our former selves (we were not good students back in the day). Too much lecturing would put us to sleep, and that caused issues when it came time to do homework.

We wished we had a tutor available 24/7 who could answer all of our questions at home - when we would try to catch up on the material we’d missed during class.

Alex dropped out of college at 19 and he’s been plotting how to reform education ever since. I spent the last four years working in ed-tech and AI at Photomath, and then [@Speak](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/1443) (W17), where I helped build an AI language tutor on GPT3 & 4. Alex and I previously worked together [@Starcity](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/1431) (S16) before creating Studdy.

Education is one of the largest and most influential industries in the world, with +20% of the global population being students.

Yet, today’s education system still follows the assembly-line approach from the industrial revolution—leaving students stuck with standardized, one-size-fits-all learning methods that create three major pains:

2. Emotional stress
3. Wasted time

At Alice, we’re a team of former teachers and AI experts using the latest technology to make personalized learning more accessible. 

Alice turns generic course materials into personalized learning and exam prep using AI. Students simply upload what they want to study and instantly get access to:

* **Better understanding** 📚: Key topic overviews with support from an AI chat that knows their context.  
* **Effective practicing** 📝: Tailored exercises (level, format, curriculum, etc.), including flashcards, multiple-choice questions, and full exam simulations and grading.

launches.body:
**TL;DR:**

The core system of record in education -- the student information system (SIS) -- is broken. Schools run all of their software on top of it, but most teachers and administrators avoid using their SIS as much as possible. Traditionally, the SIS has been a database with a UI, but we believe that the SIS of the future will be providing “compliance-as-a-service”, handling every administrative task schools have to deal with, so educators at every level can focus on optimizing instruction.

[Demo](https://www.loom.com/share/584f0389606f4b88841efcce59df740c?sid=9e5b78bd-fc67-4341-a299-7d86bb699c16)

**Automated Compliance 💫**

By law, schools have to collect and report mountains of data. It takes large teams of people a ton of time to ingest, validate, audit, and report data to the government. They develop their own manual pipelines to try to improve these processes, but there’s no unified pipeline, and it often involves several rounds of manual auditing to make sure the data is accurate.

Even with all of these redundant checks, these are manual processes, and schools make mistakes. When the annual audit comes around, schools lose funding for every mistake - and it can come out to hundreds of thousands of dollars in losses.

Scout automates the entire school compliance pipeline, from data ingestion to internal audits to government reporting. Our AI agents use drip campaigns to remind parents and students to submit documents, we continuously monitor all data for compliance throughout the school year, and Scout’s end-to-end reporting features compress reporting from a month-long process to something that can be done in a few hours.

**AI-powered outreach**

One of the biggest time-sinks in compliance is that teachers need to constantly reach out to families for data and documents, track submissions in spreadsheets, continue to follow-up until everything’s been submitted, and then manually validate each document, starting the whole cycle again if something’s invalid. We’ve heard some teachers refer to themselves as “professional nags”.

Other industries that are outreach-heavy have already solved this problem. For example, HubSpot has solved this for sales by automating follow-ups until prospects respond.

Scout treats each student like a customer in a CRM: students moves through a variety of funnels, from annual tasks like enrollment and re-enrollment to daily tasks like tracking attendance or engagement with online curriculum providers. Scout’s built-in drip campaigns make sure students and parents complete tasks without teacher or administrator involvement, only flagging the students who need attention and removing the burden on schools to manually track all of these funnels.

Scout’s AI agents automatically reach out to parents and students via phone, email, text, and the Scout mobile app to get them to fill out forms, upload documents, mark excused absences, and more.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87832&key=user_uploads/1495921/093d586b-f015-49f7-8bae-ef39d01de1ce)

Right now, schools put multiple levels of compliance checks in place to make sure that submitted documents are valid. To reduce the number of humans that need to check over each document, Scout proactively scans every document for compliance on ingestion, highlighting exactly what’s wrong and how to fix it. With Scout, schools reduce the possibility for human errors while avoiding the back and forth that comes with invalid documentation.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87832&key=user_uploads/1495921/4b705cad-b848-44fb-bf55-4d6530b68add)

**24/7 internal audits**

Throughout the course of the school year, Scout monitors every dimension of compliance, highlighting only the items that need attention. With Scout, schools can shift their mental model from checking every single document and database row for compliance to only looking at the ones that are out of compliance - saving as much as 95% of the time they spend on compliance tasks.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87832&key=user_uploads/1495921/1b4e76e6-86cd-49fe-943b-64a4f0f655c4)

**End-to-end government reporting**

Throughout the school year, California schools need to report information to a number of state and federal bodies, including the California Department of Education (via a number of systems like CALPADS, PADC, and ConApp), and the federal Department of Education’s Office of Civil Rights. These reports often take weeks to compile, because data errors aren’t discovered until submission, and understanding exactly what’s wrong and how to fix it is an extremely time-consuming process. Current SIS providers don’t report directly to the state, so schools are exporting CSVs, and their edits aren’t reflected in the SIS.

Scout manages the reporting process end-to-end with proactive error discovery, a step-by-step error resolution flow, and automated submission without leaving the page.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87832&key=user_uploads/1495921/344b8853-ec8c-451d-84c0-6e95c6ee5cc4)

We met on the first day of high school in 2013, and we’ve been best friends ever since, hacking on side projects like sneaker bots throughout high school and college.

Hey everyone 👋, we’re David, Soami, and Achyut from [Hanji](https://hanji.dev/). \
\
At YouLearn, we processed **70M pages for 2.5M users.** To handle 500 page textbooks, handwritten notes, and scanned documents with broken tables, we built our own document parser. We launched it as an API and didn’t expect healthcare, government, and insurance teams to be the first to reach out. But after talking with them, **we realized they still couldn’t find a pipeline they could rely on in production.** 

<https://youtu.be/S5OVXZVv61A>

### **Problem**

As companies process more documents with hard formats, **they either build in-house and take on the cost of maintaining it, or use a provider and accept tradeoffs they cannot control.**

* **Build:** It can work at a certain scale, but as volume increases and harder formats come in, your team has to keep fixing the pipeline. Over time, you end up maintaining something that was never your product.
* **Buy:** Providers can work too, but you have to accept tradeoffs you cannot change. They may cost too much, take too long at higher volumes, or miss important cases that your team then has to fix.

In both scenarios, your team pays for these tradeoffs through more engineering time, slower workflows, or lower margins.

### **Our Solution**

**Hanji tunes the document pipeline to your workflow,** so you don’t have to maintain it yourself or accept fixed tradeoffs.

Send us your hardest docs, and we’ll take care of the rest by tuning your pipeline **to the accuracy, speed, and cost you need.** And when human review is still necessary in your document workflow, we’ll improve that process too, such as by adding field-level confidence scores and review flags.

### **Benchmark**

Even before tuning, **Hanji holds the highest text accuracy across five providers** on our benchmark: 400 human-verified pages spanning seven document types.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=108085&key=user_uploads/1378551/eb2e7fbd-b541-4b77-93fe-e29fb3af7948)

_Text accuracy, 400 human-verified pages, 95% CIs. Full methodology [here](https://hanji.dev/bench)._

### **Results**

After tuning Hanji to each customer’s document workflow, one YC healthcare company improved their text accuracy from **71% on our first pass to 96.5% within a few days.** Another reduced its end-to-end latency from **1.5 minutes to under 1 minute** with Hanji extracting **78/78 fields** containing payer to member ID associations across 53 packets. And another company **reduced its projected processing costs by 75%** after we implemented a routing step that found the relevant forms in every packet.

In each case, we started with their own documents, tuned the pipeline around what matters for their workflow, and kept improving it as new failures appeared.

### **Our Ask**

**Try your hardest docs in the playground [here](https://hanji.dev/dashboard/playground),** then [book a call](https://cal.com/team/youlearnai/hanji-intro) to see how we can improve your accuracy, speed, or review process.

launches.body:
Hey there 👋

We’re [James](https://x.com/J4mesBooth) and [Max](https://x.com/MaxB00th) - brothers and cofounders of [Chiron](https://projectchiron.org).

# 📌 **TL;DR**

Chiron is an [iPad app](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/project-chiron/id6502346822) that understands math as it’s written - like Grammarly for algebra. We’re both Oxford math grads, have tutored for a decade, and we’re creating the future of learning which will be entirely 1-on-1.

[Launch Video](https://youtu.be/Ec8Nwe0EaSU)

# ❌ **Problem**

With AI that’s so great at math, why can’t it teach at near-human quality?

* Math is handwritten ✏️
* Math has to be practiced not read 🧮
* AI is rubbish at spotting _your_ mistakes 🔍

# ✅ **Solution**

* Freeform writing on a whiteboard app ✍️
* Accuracy of a calculator with symbolic logic 🔢
* Real-time feedback on every stroke (< 300ms) ⚡

# ⚙️ **How we do it?**

With tens of thousands of lines of Python and Wolfram Language code. Writing on an iPad, we convert the stroke data to LaTeX, parse it, ask a million symbolic questions about it with reference to the problem’s _ground truth_ (the lines with a blue index), and assess whether it is right, wrong or something in between.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90706&key=user_uploads/1522067/b06893f5-bab0-4021-b09e-c8d38b33e4ee)

We do **not** rely on the vibes of a language model to assess the details of their working - too slow and unreliable. Many students give up on LLMs for genuine collaboration when they mislead them on topics the student finds difficult.

**We can handle a lot of math already.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90706&key=user_uploads/1522067/df464a12-f051-4c0a-8c03-90e660079c40)

# **💡 Core insight**

We tried all the AI tutor desktop formulations we could imagine, but beyond the obvious interface challenge, AI is exceptionally poor at spotting the subtle mistakes students often make. LLMs are great at doing correct math, but much worse at pulling out an error within the many lines of messy student reasoning.

We started performing a symbolic analysis of the student’s working as context for the AI to boost accuracy - **but then we realised we could give this straight to the student.** This was when we started to feel the magic.

# **🙏 Our Ask**

So far, _every_ single teacher we’ve demoed our iPad app to in person has immediately started work greenlighting a pilot. Let us know if you can introduce us to any math teachers teaching between Algebra I and Calculus I.

And you can check out Chiron on the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/project-chiron/id6502346822) now - or share with any students who might benefit from it!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90706&key=user_uploads/1522067/7b18b9c0-1e00-49fa-a8bb-d6ab7bb7d080)

Cheers, James & Max

launches.body:
**Hi everyone - I'm Alex, founder of Bloomy.**

**TL;DR: We help kids learn faster by using AI. In early pilots, students grew \~2x faster than the national average.**

[Bloomy](https://bloomylearning.com) is an AI-powered mastery learning platform for K-12 students. We diagnose students’ skill gaps, place students on a personalized learning path, and give them standards-aligned lessons and a Socratic AI tutor that helps without just giving away the answer.

Launch video: <https://youtu.be/8E5PhhWjtD4>

**Why I'm building this**

I started as a teacher. I taught 7th grade English and Writing with Teach For America, and every day I struggled to deliver differentiated instruction to 30 students with 30 different sets of needs.

Some students needed remediation, some needed acceleration, and many needed a tutor sitting next to them helping them reason through the next step. Benjamin Bloom's 2-sigma result always felt obviously true to me; the hard part was making that kind of tutoring affordable and available to every child.

Then AI changed the cost curve. 

When I saw innovative school concepts such as Alpha School, the model clicked: mastery-based learning, personalization, and high-agency students. But I kept thinking about the families and schools that already exist: homeschool families, microschools, hybrid schools, and regular classrooms where most kids are today.

**What Bloomy does**

Bloomy starts with a diagnostic (we integrate with third-party diagnostics and provide our own in-house one) and places each student onto a personalized learning path. Students work one skill at a time, get a short, standards-aligned lesson, practice, ask BloomyBot for Socratic help when they're stuck, and only move forward after showing 90%+ mastery. The skill path updates live based on the student’s performance and our own knowledge graph.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=104376&key=user_uploads/3410278/aff91335-737d-4b76-bcc2-40414d3f3c08)

_Our knowledge graph informs skill progression to make learning more efficient._

Parents and teachers can see what the student has mastered, what's in progress, and where they need support.

**Where we are**

We're being adopted in many different contexts: districts with traditional schools, charter schools, hybrid schools, microschools, homeschools, and even families who just want some extra academic support for their kids.

Families can subscribe to Bloomy monthly or annually, and families using ESA/EFA funds may also qualify for direct pay or reimbursement depending on their state’s rules.

Before Bloomy, I taught with TFA, earned my Master’s in Education, designed GMAT and GRE curriculum for Manhattan Prep, led Lyft’s driver growth team for New England, earned an MBA from Stanford, and managed AI transformation engagements at McKinsey. Bloomy is the thing that combines all the aspects of my career: learning design, go-to-market, and AI.

If you want to reach out, you can email me at [alex@bloomylearning.com](mailto:alex@bloomylearning.com) or follow our updates on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/bloomy-yc-s26/).
